summary: The Grid document contains utility functions for handling UI elements such as buttons, details, and controls in web applications. It provides methods to show, hide, add, edit, and delete UI components, ensuring proper user interaction based on the screen's editability and the specific UI state.
purpose: This document serves as a utility to manage user interface components dynamically within a web application, focusing on maintaining user interaction integrity and controlling UI element behavior depending on user permissions and data status.

workflows.name: UI Controls Management
steps: Determine screen editability and component state
Use methods to dynamically manage UI components
Show or hide components based on editability
Switch components between add, edit, and view modes
Customize user confirmation prompts using JavaScript

business_rules: Buttons should be hidden or shown based on screen's editability status
Text boxes should be set to read-only and other controls disabled on non-editable screens
Confirmation dialogs should be used for critical actions like delete
conditions: Determine if the screen is editable
Check if a row or item is inactive
Evaluate system admin privileges for certain actions
system_behavior: Handle UI elements dynamically to enhance user experience
Prevent unauthorized actions by controlling UI component visibility and functionality
exceptions: Attempting to interact with disabled or non-visible components should have no effect
